verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Parahelp's security page, which says workspace admins can disable all personal data storage so Parahelp does not retain it. That limits what data exists to train on, but nothing explicitly addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models or offers a training opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment or opt-out control, documentation of the policy covering third-party model providers, and independent corroboration.
